The camera is positioned low from her boyfriend’s point of view, angled slightly upward toward her face and the diagonal neckline, at a very close distance. 24mm smartphone wide-angle lens, natural perspective distortion, clearly visible spatial depth, with her face occupying the upper-center portion of the frame. Vertical composition that feels like an unplanned everyday moment captured by her boyfriend rather than a selfie.

A single warm floor lamp illuminates the scene from one side. The television is turned off. Sofa cushions are casually arranged and slightly uneven, with two drinking glasses placed close together nearby. Natural skin texture with subtle pores, realistic individual hair strands and fine baby hairs, clearly visible fabric folds in the wrap blouse and skirt. Slight natural image grain, imperfect spontaneous framing, authentic smartphone perspective, gently blurred background, no studio lighting, no beauty filter, no excessive retouching.

Everyday snapshot aesthetic, photorealistic, spontaneous, intimate but tasteful, candid relationship moment, realistic indoor lighting, natural imperfections, as if her boyfriend captured the exact moment she looked at him playfully and intensely before he could take a second photo.
